guarantees.claim: data_o[b] is always assigned to prng_key[RndCnstLfsrPerm[b]] for all bits b in [0, Width-1].

assumptions.claim: Each entry of parameter RndCnstLfsrPerm is a valid index into prng_key (0 <= RndCnstLfsrPerm[b] < $bits(prng_key)).
assumptions.risk: Out-of-bounds read causes X propagation on data_o, corrupting masked key output and potentially breaking security.

uncertain_points.claim: The static bit-permutation from prng_key to data_o may not be sufficient cryptographic masking; it cannot be determined from this chunk alone whether prng_key is a proper random stream and whether the permutation is designed for side-channel resistance.
uncertain_points.cond: when prng_key is not randomized or permutation is not SCA-adequate
uncertain_points.risk: Inadequate masking could leak secret key bits via side-channels.

uncertain_points.claim: The parameter RndCnstLfsrPerm may not be a bijective permutation. Duplicate entries or missing indices would reduce entropy of data_o, weakening masking.
uncertain_points.risk: Loss of entropy in masked output can undermine side-channel protection.
